# PM-<date>-<slug>            Severity: S1..S4   Type: I-1..I-5
Timeline        — detection → classification → mitigation
                  → resolution (timestamps)
Budget burn     — minutes, attributed: platform | external (9.2)
Detection audit — WHICH detector fired, HOW LATE,
                  what would have caught it sooner
Money           — direct spend impact (I-3) and mitigation cost
Behavior        — did answers change during mitigation?
                  (cross-model fallback honesty)
Actions         — each with owner, date, and the test
                  that proves it done
